name: B10-0365/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position ahead of a decision at the United Nations in autumn 2025 on whether to renew the Internet Governance Forum's mandate, which runs out on 31 December 2025. The Forum is a place where governments, companies and civil society discuss how the internet is run. The Parliament asks the United Nations to renew the mandate permanently and give the Forum more resources, and asks European Union countries and institutions to keep supporting it.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is the Parliament's opinion; the United Nations decides on renewal.
- **Who it affects:** The Forum, its secretariat, European Union governments and the Commission.
- **What happens next:** The United Nations General Assembly reviews the mandate in autumn 2025.
